info.name: Mindbody Public API v6 Appointment Subscriptions API
Mindbody This Endpoint Searches for Subscriptions Associated with Your

items.docs: This endpoint searches for subscriptions associated with your developer portal account: You can retrieve a specific subscription by calling GET(by ID).

info.name: Mindbody This Endpoint Creates a Pending Subscription That is Linked to Your

items.docs: This endpoint creates a pending subscription that is linked to your developer portal account. After you have created a subscription, you can activate it using the PATCH Subscription endpoint.

info.name: Mindbody This Endpoint Finds and Returns the Single Subscription Associated

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Returns the single location identified by this ID (a GUID).

items.docs: This endpoint finds and returns the single subscription associated with the passed ID.

info.name: Mindbody This Endpoint Can Activate a New Subscription or Reactivate an

items.docs: This endpoint can activate a new subscription or reactivate an inactive subscription that is associated with your developer portal account, by updating the status. You can also update your subscription’s eventIds, eventSchemaVersion, referenceId, and webhookUrl.

info.name: Mindbody This Endpoint Deactivates a Subscription Associated with the Passed ID

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The subscription ID (a GUID) that you are deactivating.

items.docs: This endpoint deactivates a subscription associated with the passed ID.
